Tata Steel Sells Jamshedpur FC for Nominal Amount

Tata Steel has approved the sale of its Indian Super League football club, Jamshedpur FC, to Churchill Brothers for a nominal sum of INR 100. This transaction will facilitate Churchill Brothers' entry into the ISL. The deal involves the acquisition of the entire stake in the club.
